items.title: ColdRiver Drops Fresh Malware on Targets
items.description: The Russia-backed threat actor's latest cyber spying campaign is a classic example of how quickly sophisticated hacking groups can pivot when exposed.

items.title: DNS0.EU private DNS service shuts down over sustainability issues
items.description: The DNS0.EU non-profit public DNS service focused on European users announced its immediate shut down due to time and resource constraints. [...]

items.title: International Sting Takes Down SIM Box Criminal Network
items.description: The operation took down a massive SIM card fraud network that provided fake phone numbers from more than 80 countries to criminals.

items.title: Is Your Car a BYOD Risk? Researchers Demonstrate How
items.description: If an employee's phone connects to their car and then their corporate network, an attack against the car can reach the company.

items.title: Flawed Vendor Guidance Exposes Enterprises to Avoidable Risk
items.description: Oracle E-Business Suite customers received conflicting deployment guidance, leaving enterprises exposed a recent zero-day flaw, Andrew argues.

items.title: New Microchip Tech Protects Vehicles from Laser Attacks
items.description: "FD-SOI" makes hardware attacks on silicon chips more difficult. And, researchers argue, it'll help OEMs with regulatory compliance.
